recipes.title: Pumpkin mac 'n' cheese
recipes.description:
Baked wholewheat macaroni in a creamy pumpkin sauce, with vegetables and crispy bacon.

Preheat the oven to 200 °C.

Bring a pan of water to the boil and cook the macaroni for 8 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside.

Meanwhile, peel and finely chop the garlic. Strip the leaves from the thyme.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan and fry the pumpkin with the garlic and thyme for 5 minutes over medium heat.

Add the cooking cream, 100 ml water and the stock cube and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes, then blend with a hand blender. Set the pumpkin sauce aside.

Meanwhile, heat a wok or frying pan without oil and fry the bacon strips for 5 minutes over medium heat.

Add the mixed vegetables to the bacon and fry for another 5 minutes over medium heat.

Mix the macaroni, pumpkin sauce, vegetables with bacon and ¾ of the cheese.

Spoon into an oven dish, sprinkle over the rest of the cheese and bake for 15 minutes until golden on top.

Tip: lovely with fresh basil.
Veggie tip: use plant-based bacon strips instead of bacon.
ingredients: 355 g mixed vegetables (leek, carrot, cabbage), sliced

recipes.title: Butter chicken
recipes.description:
Creamy, mildly spiced chicken curry with butternut squash and tomatoes, served with rice.

Prepare the vegetables. Peel the squash, halve it, remove the seeds and cut into 2 cm cubes. Cut the tomatoes into chunks. Peel and finely chop the ginger. Peel the onions and garlic; dice the onions and finely chop the garlic. Cut the chicken into cubes.

Heat 1 tbsp sunflower oil in a deep frying pan and fry the onion, ginger and garlic for 2 minutes over high heat.

Add the chicken and fry for 3 minutes over high heat.

Add the tomato paste and spice mix and fry for 1 minute over high heat.

Add the tomatoes, squash and 200 ml water, bring to the boil and simmer gently with the lid on for 20–25 minutes.

Cook the rice according to the packet.

Stir in the butter and cooking cream and let it heat through.

Serve the butter chicken with the rice.

Tip: sprinkle with coriander and/or serve with poppadoms.
Veggie tip: use 400 g cooked lentils instead of chicken.
ingredients: Butter chicken spice mix (garam masala, cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili)

recipes.title: Gnocchi traybake
recipes.description:
Gnocchi, chicken and vegetables roasted together in tomato sauce on one tray.

Preheat the oven to 200 °C.

Mix the herbs with the olive oil.

Halve the chicken tenders lengthways.

Spread the gnocchi, vegetables, chicken, tomato sauce and herb oil over an oven dish or a baking tray lined with baking paper and mix together.

Bake for about 25 minutes in the middle of the oven, stirring halfway.

Divide between plates.

Tip: lovely with Parmesan and fresh basil.
Veggie tip: use mozzarella instead of chicken; tear it over the gnocchi.
ingredients: 600 g mixed vegetables (bell pepper, courgette, red onion), cut into pieces
Italian herb mix (oregano, basil, garlic, paprika)
Parmesan and fresh basil, to serve

recipes.title: Moroccan couscous
recipes.description:
Spiced beef mince with courgette, aubergine and pepper, stewed together with couscous and raisins.

Prepare the vegetables. Cut the courgette, aubergine and pepper into rough chunks. Peel the onion and garlic; dice the onion and finely chop the garlic.

Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large deep pan and brown the mince. Add the onion and garlic and fry for 2 minutes over medium heat, then stir in the spice mix. Add the vegetables and raisins. Pour in 200 ml water, cover and stew for 12 minutes over medium heat until cooked.

Put the couscous in a large bowl and add 250 ml boiling water and 1 tbsp oil. Cover straight away with a lid or cling film and leave for 10 minutes.

Stir the herb paste into the pan. Fluff up the couscous with a fork, add it to the pan and mix. Cover and stew for another 5 minutes over low heat.

Tip: add chopped dried apricots with the raisins in step 2, and serve with fresh mint.
Vegan tip: use 400 g chickpeas instead of mince.
ingredients: Moroccan spice mix (ras el hanout: cumin, cinnamon, coriander, paprika)
1 tbsp harissa or Moroccan herb paste
